about: 馬 through its scripts, a sample for the user, 2026-09-28: 'Sure do 1' (a character through its scripts: bone, bronze, seal, then the kaishu, each redrawn in neon from the one before). The older forms are public-domain SVGs of Wikimedia Commons' Ancient Chinese Characters Project; the kaishu is Make Me a Hanzi's. Labels say 'carved on bone', never the word the copy rules ban.
